checks.name: Saved-file deletion runs outside the Android main thread
The controlled device supports real MediaStore Downloads
Published MediaStore and profile-7 private APK bytes are readable
Deleting the selected MediaStore APK reports its actual size and removes its row
A same-name private APK in another profile survives MediaStore deletion
Deleting a profile-7 private APK removes its physical payload and both shared indexes
Same-name destinations in another profile and directory retain their exact bytes
An unrelated progress save and late add/sync cannot resurrect a deleted saved file
Reopening profile tasks and migrating legacy history keep the deletion durable
A later download with a fresh id and timestamp may reuse the exact destination URI
An old captured menu cannot delete a newer download at the same URI
A same-URI delete actually waits inside the active publication lease
After the writer publishes a new identity the old deletion preserves its bytes and index
Late old-slot add/sync cannot replace a newer saved identity from another profile
An already absent private payload clears stale metadata without claiming freed bytes
A known empty MediaStore query clears stale metadata without claiming freed bytes
Provider deletion failure retains its exact file bytes and indexed metadata
A stale or unindexed identity cannot delete another saved payload
Cancelling the rendered confirmation preserves the file and its metadata
Unrelated same-name saved files remain readable after every deletion and failure case
